metaTitle: Best Plug In Wall Sconces in 2026
metaDescription: Six plug in wall sconces compared on dimming, bulb type, cord reach and shade style, so you can add bedside or sofa side light without an electrician.
expertTake: The Yunaking set is the most flexible pair here because it offers adjustable color temperature and two ways to mount. The YXTH industrial pair is the value pick when you want simple, bulb swappable light. Skip plug in sconces if you cannot tolerate a visible cord or if you need the light to switch on with a wall switch.
introParagraphs: A plug in wall sconce gives a room the layered look of hardwired fixtures without opening a wall. The trade is a visible cord, a switch or dimmer somewhere along it, and a mounting method that has to carry the weight of the arm and shade.

Most buyers use them beside a bed, a sofa or a reading chair, so the questions that matter are how the light is controlled, how the arm swings, whether the bulb can be replaced, and how the finish reads next to your other fixtures.

products.name: Yunaking Plug In Wall Sconces Set of 2, 3 Color Temps
products.description:
The Yunaking pair is built around a simple idea: one fixture that can be set up in more than one way and tuned to the mood of the room. The listing describes two mount methods, so you can either screw the backplate to the wall or use a quicker hanging approach, and the bulbs are 9W LEDs in a standard E26 base. That base matters because a standard socket means you can change brightness or color later with any compatible bulb instead of living with whatever shipped in the box.

The three selectable color temperatures are the feature that separates this set from the fixed warm white pairs below it. You can run a warm setting for evening television and a cooler one when you want to read or fold laundry, which suits a living room that does several jobs. The tradeoff is that a switch handles color and on/off rather than a smooth dimmer knob, so it is less graceful than the VATONI set when you want to creep brightness down by small steps.

Ownership is straightforward. Plan on a stud or a proper anchor for the backplate, a surface wide enough for the shade, and a cord that either runs to a nearby outlet or is hidden with a paintable cord cover. Because it is the least expensive tier in this lineup, expect lighter metal than the TRLIFE brass pair, and handle the arm gently the first few weeks until you learn how it moves.
products.bestFor: Living rooms and bedrooms where one pair of sconces has to handle both reading and relaxing light.
pros: Three color temperatures from one fixture
Standard E26 socket allows bulb swaps
Two mounting options suit renters or owners
Sold as a pair for symmetrical layouts
cons: Color steps are fixed rather than smooth dimming
Lighter build than the brass pairs in this guide

products.name: VATONI Dimmable Plug In Sconces, Adjustable Angle Pair
products.description:
VATONI puts the dimmer where you can reach it: a knob on the backplate that turns the light on, off and up or down. Two dimmable 6W bulbs at 2700K are included, which is the color temperature most people expect from a lamp in a living room. The arm joint tilts up and down by about 180 degrees and swivels sideways, so the head can wash the wall or point at a book.

The knob is a better daily experience than an inline cord switch, since you rarely have to reach for a dangling control. The cost is that the knob sits on the backplate, so the sconce needs to be within arm's reach from the bed or the sofa arm. Against the Yunaking, you lose the color temperature choice but gain a true dimmer, and for evening use that is the more valuable trade.

Assembly is a matter of marking two screw holes, leveling the plate and snapping the arm on. Dimmable bulbs are essential here, so if you ever swap them, buy bulbs labeled dimmable or the light will flicker at low settings. The adjustable head also means a little drift over a few years; a quarter turn of the joint screw usually restores friction.
products.bestFor: Evening reading and television where you want fine control of brightness from the wall.
pros: Backplate dimmer knob needs no remote
Warm 2700K dimmable bulbs included
Arm tilts about 180 degrees and swivels
Standard E26 socket
cons: Knob placement needs the sconce within reach

products.name: TRLIFE Brushed Brass Swing Arm Sconces with Fabric Shade
products.description:
The TRLIFE pair is the one to pick when appearance matters as much as light. The arms are metal in a brushed brass finish and the shade is a large white fabric drum, which diffuses the bulb into a soft glow instead of a hot spot. The listing notes two included bulbs described as 60W equivalent in a 6W dimmable LED, and a rotary dimmer on the backplate.

It shares its dimmer approach with the VATONI set, but the larger fabric shade changes how the light behaves. Light comes out the top and bottom as well as the front, so it reads as ambient rather than directional. If you want a pinpoint beam over a book, the VATONI head or the YXTH industrial shade points light more precisely.

Fabric shades collect dust and show fingerprints, so a lint roller and a soft brush every month or two keeps them tidy. The brass finish is a coating on the metal, so avoid abrasive cleaners that could dull it. Check that the shade clears the headboard or the sofa back by a couple of inches before you commit to the position, because the shade is wider than the slim industrial arms.
products.bestFor: Bedrooms and traditional or transitional living rooms that want a finished, fabric shaded look.
pros: Brushed brass finish suits warm interiors
Large fabric shade softens the light
Rotary dimmer on the backplate
Bulbs included in the box
cons: Light is diffuse rather than a focused reading beam

products.name: Nathan James Millie Plug In Sconce with Cotton Shade
products.description:
Nathan James sells Millie as a single bedside or reading lamp, which makes it the pick when you only need one light, such as one side of a bed or one end of a sofa. The shade is cotton, the back plate has a brass tone, and the cord switch is dressed in a gold colored stem so it looks intentional instead of utilitarian. The listing says you can use it with or without wiring, which gives a path to hardwiring later.

Compared with the two pair sets above, you pay a premium per light for the design and the brand. The lamp is also bought separately, so a symmetrical bedroom needs two orders and a bit of care that finishes match. You are also responsible for choosing a dimmable bulb if you want dimming, since the switch is on the cord and does not dim.

It is a nice object, and it suits people who want a sconce to look more like furniture than like hardware. Mounting is simple, but because it is a single fixture, think through cord routing before drilling. A paintable cord cover in the wall color makes the cord almost vanish.
products.bestFor: One sided bedside or reading nooks that need a single, good looking light.
pros: Designed look with cotton shade and brass plate
Plug in now, hardwire later option
Works well as a single accent light
Cord switch is neatly finished
cons: Sold as one light, so pairs cost more
No built in dimmer, needs a dimmable bulb

products.name: YXTH Black Industrial Plug In Sconces Set of 2
products.description:
YXTH is the straightforward, inexpensive industrial pair. It is a black metal fixture with a vintage style, an E26 socket that the listing says is UL certified for the socket, and an on/off switch. It works with a standard bulb, including incandescent, halogen or LED, and the listing cautions about the maximum bulb wattage, so read the tag on the socket before you choose a bulb.

Because it does not include a built in dimmer or color control, the YXTH is only as good as the bulb you put in it. That is also its strength: a decorative Edison style LED looks right in the open shade, and you can choose a warm 2700K bulb or a daylight one for a workshop corner. Against the Yunaking, you get less convenience, but a cleaner, simpler fixture and the freedom to pick the bulb.

Black metal hides dust well and the open shade makes cleaning easy. Be mindful that exposed bulbs can glare in your eyeline when seated, so aim them away from where you look or choose a frosted or amber bulb. For a game room, den or industrial loft, this is the least fussy way to get symmetrical wall light.
products.bestFor: Industrial, loft or den looks where you want to choose your own bulbs.
pros: Simple black metal in a matte industrial style
Standard E26 socket takes any compatible bulb
Pair is the most affordable tier here
Open shade is easy to dust
cons: Exposed bulbs can glare when seated
No dimmer, so buy dimmable bulbs plus a plug in dimmer

products.name: GOODATE Dimmable White Fabric Shade Sconces 22 Inch
products.description:
GOODATE lists real dimensions, which helps: 22 inches tall and 6.3 inches wide overall, with white fabric shades. That slim profile makes the pair a good match for narrow walls, the space between a headboard and a door, or either side of a small sofa. The included bulbs are described as 800 lumens at 2700K, which is enough to read by when the shade is aimed correctly.

The rotary dimmer reaches a very low level, which the listing describes as 1 to 100 percent. In practice that means a gentle night light setting and a full reading setting from the same fixture. Compared with the TRLIFE set, the GOODATE shade is narrower and the fixture is more compact, so it takes less visual space but spreads light over a smaller area.

The main caution is cord management: a 22 inch fixture in a small room puts the cord in plain view, so plan the outlet location. For a compact bedroom or hallway, this is the neatest dimmable pair in the group.
products.bestFor: Compact rooms and narrow walls that need a slim, dimmable pair.
pros: Slim 22 by 6.3 inch footprint
Rotary dimmer reaches a very low level
800 lumen warm bulbs included
White fabric shade fits most decor
cons: Narrow shade covers a smaller area
Cord shows in tight rooms without a cover

buyingCriteria.explanation: Plug in sconces control light in three ways: a backplate knob, an inline cord switch, or nothing at all. A backplate knob like the one on the VATONI and TRLIFE sets is the easiest to live with, because the control is where the light is. An inline switch such as the Yunaking uses is fine for on and off but cannot fine tune. If your pair has no dimmer, like the YXTH, buy dimmable bulbs and add a plug in dimmer at the outlet. The common mistake is buying a dimmer sconce and then fitting a non dimmable bulb, which buzzes and flickers.

A standard E26 socket lets you replace the bulb in five years without replacing the fixture. Every sconce in this guide uses an E26 base. Integrated LED panels look cleaner but end the life of the fixture when the driver fails. Check the maximum wattage printed on the socket and do not exceed it, especially under fabric shades like the TRLIFE and GOODATE, which trap heat. A 6W LED producing about 800 lumens is far below the limit that matters.

The plug in design means a cord will cross the wall. Measure from the sconce position to the nearest outlet, and add a few inches for the drop. In most rooms a 6 to 15 foot cord is typical, and the cord color matters more than people expect. Paintable cord covers and raceways in the wall color make the cord almost vanish, and they cost far less than an electrician. Buyers regret long cords hanging loose more than any other defect.

Sconces carry the weight of the arm and shade at the end of a lever. Screw the backplate into a stud when possible, and use rated anchors in drywall. The Yunaking lists two mounting methods, which helps renters who prefer a quick option. Hooks and adhesive systems are fine for a light sconce but check them carefully before you trust them near a bed. A drooping sconce usually means the plate was anchored only to drywall.

A fabric shade like the TRLIFE drum or the GOODATE cylinder diffuses light and glows evenly, so it suits ambient lighting. An open metal shade like the YXTH sends light further but exposes the bulb. Match the shade to the job: diffuse for atmosphere, directional for reading. If you read in bed, make sure the beam can be angled down rather than only washing the wall.

Measure the fixture height and width against your wall. The GOODATE pair is 22 inches tall and 6.3 inches wide, which suits narrow walls, while a swing arm set can project further into the room. Allow clearance from headboards, curtains and doors. A common mounting height puts the bottom of the shade around 55 to 60 inches from the floor, or about 20 inches above a seated shoulder.

specDecoder.meaning: Lumens measure the light a bulb produces, while watts measure the electricity it draws. An 800 lumen bulb is about the output of an old 60 watt incandescent.
specDecoder.watchFor: The GOODATE lists 800 lumens, but the 6W TRLIFE and VATONI bulbs describe a 60W equivalent, so compare lumens rather than watts.

specDecoder.meaning: Kelvin describes how warm or cool white light looks. 2700K is the cozy glow of a lamp, 4000K is a neutral office white and 6000K looks blue.
specDecoder.watchFor: The Yunaking offers three color settings, while the VATONI and GOODATE are fixed at 2700K.

specDecoder.meaning: E26 is the standard medium screw base for North American household bulbs. It means the bulb can be replaced from any hardware store.
specDecoder.watchFor: All six sconces here use an E26 socket, but only some ship with bulbs, so check the YXTH, which expects you to supply them.

specDecoder.meaning: A dimmable LED has circuitry that tolerates reduced power. A non dimmable LED on a dimmer will flicker, hum or fail early.
specDecoder.watchFor: The VATONI, TRLIFE and GOODATE include dimmable bulbs, so keep that type when you replace them.

specDecoder.meaning: A cord switch only turns the light on or off, usually partway down the cord. A backplate dimmer controls brightness at the fixture.
specDecoder.watchFor: The Nathan James Millie uses a cord switch, so it needs a dimmable bulb plus a separate dimmer to fade.

howWeEvaluated.title: Control and dimming
howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at where the controls sit and how finely they adjust. A backplate dimmer, such as the VATONI knob, scored above a cord switch like the Millie's. A fixture with color control, like the Yunaking, earned credit for flexibility.

howWeEvaluated.title: Bulb system
howWeEvaluated.description: We checked whether the socket accepts standard bulbs and whether bulbs ship in the box. An E26 socket and included dimmable bulbs, as on the TRLIFE, mean you can use the light the day it arrives and replace the bulb later. Integrated sources were treated as a durability risk.

howWeEvaluated.title: Mounting and wiring
howWeEvaluated.description: We read the listing and spec sheet for mount methods, backplate type and the cord. Sets that offer two mount methods, or a hardwire option like the Millie, score for flexibility. Weight and arm length also matter for wall stress.

howWeEvaluated.title: Light quality and diffusion
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared shade styles and listed outputs. The GOODATE at 800 lumens and the VATONI with 2700K bulbs suit living areas, while the open YXTH shade trades diffusion for a bolder style. Fabric shades soften glare.

howWeEvaluated.title: Fit and finish
howWeEvaluated.description: We judged the finish against the likely room, from the TRLIFE brushed brass to the YXTH black metal. Footprint counted too: the 22 inch GOODATE suits narrow walls where a wider shade would not.

cards.label: Fabric shade
cards.text: The TRLIFE, GOODATE and Millie diffuse the bulb. The glow is soft and even, and the bulb is hidden, which prevents glare. The cost is less directional light, so these suit ambient and bedside use better than detailed tasks.

cards.label: Open shade
cards.text: The YXTH and VATONI heads send more light where you point them. They suit reading and accent lighting, but an exposed bulb can glare when seated. Use a frosted or low lumen bulb to soften it.

howToChoose.note: Choose fabric for atmosphere and open metal for direction and a harder style.

rows: Sold as a pair with matching finishes

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A fixture that mounts with screws that leave small holes or with a removable method, a cord that can be concealed, and a plug rather than a hardwire connection. Avoid anything that needs the outlet box to be opened.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The Yunaking pair lists two mount methods, which is the most renter friendly. The VATONI and GOODATE need only a couple of screw holes, and all six plug into a wall outlet without electrical work.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want metal arms and a fabric shade that look like real fixtures, as on the TRLIFE, or the design and hardwire option of the Millie. Also spend more if the sconce will be used every night, where a smooth dimmer pays back.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You plan to change bulbs yourself or the sconces are for a guest room. The YXTH and Yunaking offer decent light at the lowest tier, and a plug in dimmer adds control for a small amount more.

maintenance.why: Dust dulls light output and shows on fabric. A soft brush or lint roller is enough.
Arms sit at the end of a lever and loosen with turning. Tighten the plate and the joint screw.
Look for pinched insulation behind furniture. Replace any cord that is cracked or warm.
LEDs fade slowly. Use the same dimmable type to avoid flicker.
A damp cloth keeps brass and black coatings clean. Avoid abrasive cleaners that dull plating.

faq.q: Are plug in sconces safe to leave on?
faq.a: They are safe when you stay under the socket's maximum bulb wattage and keep fabric away from the bulb. LED bulbs run much cooler than incandescent ones. Do not cover the shade or place bedding against it.

faq.q: How do I hide the cord?
faq.a: Use a paintable cord cover or raceway that matches the wall. Run it straight down to the outlet and keep it parallel to trim lines. This costs far less than hardwiring and is reversible.
Use a dimmer rated for LED loads and dimmable bulbs. Sconces with a built in dimmer, like the VATONI, need no extra control. A plug in dimmer can add control to the YXTH.

faq.q: Which is better, a pair or a single sconce?
faq.a: A pair gives symmetrical light and fits above two bedside tables. A single, like the Millie, works for one reading corner. Choose based on how many places need light.

faq.q: What color temperature should I choose?
faq.a: Warm 2700K is the usual living room choice. Pick adjustable options like the Yunaking if you want a cooler setting for tasks. Avoid 6000K in evening spaces.

faq.q: Can plug in sconces be hardwired later?
faq.a: Some can. The Millie lists a plug in or wired option, while others are designed only for plugging in. Hardwiring should be done by a qualified person following local code.
